newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus asks Russia to rework $250 mln gas debt.
newsitem.headline: Belarus asks Russia to rework $250 mln gas debt.

text.p: The Belarussian government has asked Moscow to reschedule to 2010 its $250 million debt to the Russian gas monopoly Gazprom GAZP.RTS, Deputy Prime Minister Valery Kokorev said on Thursday.
"We have not received an answer yet. The problem is being discussed by Gazprom and the Russian government as it is tied up with deductions of taxes to the budget," Kokorev told a news conference.
"We are talking about rescheduling last year's debt of $250 million, as this year 90-92 percent of gas deliveries are being paid," he added.
He said current payments had been stepped up due to barter agreements whereby 60-80 percent of gas supplies were paid for with various Belarussian products.

"We have proposed various options for reconstructing the debt, including selling promissory notes, handing over shares in Belarussian companies and today we are asking for a rescheduling," Kokorev said.

Minsk's debt to Gazprom of $460 million accumulated by February 1 last year was cancelled in an inter-governmental deal in exchange for free transit across Belarussian territory and maintenance of Russian military sites.
